archive_policy.rule: When the current phase is completed, move its full progress and validation evidence to the archive before creating a fresh progress.json for the next phase.

phase.title: Human Playtest and Core Feel
phase.goal: Package a reproducible Windows build, observe structured 3–8-player multi-PC sessions, and tune core feel from evidence before expansion.

milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.title: Reproducible Windows Playtest Build
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.scope: Create a repeatable Windows export with build/version identification and direct-IP playtest instructions; verify launch and LAN session/rematch behavior without adding distribution services.
milestone_2_1_reproducible_windows_playt.acceptance: Export twice from the same clean revision with matching payload hashes or documented packaging-only differences; launch without editor/repository; verify settings/assets/audio, exported host/client flow, five rematches and disconnect/retry; confirm physical LAN smoke and matching build identity. See docs/implementation-checklist.md for the executable plan.

milestone_2_2_structured_multi_pc_playte.title: Structured Multi-PC Playtest
milestone_2_2_structured_multi_pc_playte.scope: Observe a 3–4-person session and a 6–8-person session on separate Windows PCs; aim for three normal rounds each and record actual counts, hardware/network/input/display setup, uncoached death explanations, warnings, camera/control/fairness issues, voluntary rematches and timestamped emergent causal chains.

milestone_2_3_evidence_driven_core_feel_.title: Evidence-Driven Core Feel Tuning
milestone_2_3_evidence_driven_core_feel_.scope: Prioritize reproduced high-impact issues; tune existing movement/camera/warning/pacing owners one coherent change at a time, regress and retest with humans. No new disasters, shove, map expansion or distribution services.

proposed_expansion_criteria.death_clarity: At least 80% of sampled deaths correctly explained without coaching; report numerator and denominator.
proposed_expansion_criteria.voluntary_rematches: A majority independently willing to rematch in each follow-up group; distinguish requested rounds from voluntary requests.
proposed_expansion_criteria.emergence: At least two distinct emergent causal patterns recurring across rounds.
proposed_expansion_criteria.stability: No unresolved session-blocking/control failures; recurring high-impact issues addressed with regression and human follow-up evidence. Small samples are product evidence, not statistical proof.

validation_log.result: Clean main aligned with origin/main at inspection; Phase 1 archive is completed with all required gates passed. No export preset/build script found; local Godot export_templates directory is empty. Native Windows editor binaries exist, but editor checks are not packaged executable evidence.

Exit 0; UI_REGRESSION_OK suites=26 matrices=4 persistence_restart=passed. State-contract 2/4/8/20-client and playable 4/8/20-player matrices, authority and two-peer five-rematch checks passed. This does not prove physical audio, controller feel, multi-PC sessions or Windows package behavior.

blockers: Milestone 2.1 prerequisite: matching export templates and a Windows export preset/pipeline are absent; implement Task 2.1.1 before claiming any packaged-build gate.
Milestone 2.2 requires human participants and separate Windows PCs; availability is not established and automated localhost peers cannot satisfy the gate.
